draft.subject: re-keying emailed orders
draft.body:
Hi Bethan,

Read your post about re-keying every emailed order by hand, with three people on it all day. That kind of copying tends to grow with every new customer.

We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business.

Is this on your radar?

claims.text: your post about re-keying every emailed order by hand, with three people on it all day
We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business

evidence.text: Bethan Rees, Operations Director at Moorside Trade Supplies: we still re-key every emailed order into our system by hand. Three people, all day.
Order Entry Assistant. Key customer orders from email into Sage 200.
No online ordering portal or customer login was found on the website.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
